Indonesia Earthquake: Thousands Displaced, Aid Efforts Underway

A powerful earthquake struck eastern Indonesia, causing widespread displacement and prompting aid efforts. The 7.7 magnitude quake, followed by a 5.9 magnitude aftershock, has resulted in at least 68 confirmed deaths. Search and rescue operations are ongoing, with thousands displaced and facing shortages of food and uncertainty. Aid packages are being prepared, and a ferry is being used to provide solace and support in affected areas.
